description: Read one Felix Arc settlement journey by its settlement operation id. By default it runs the owner-scoped reconcile step, which advances bookkeeping from chain and Circle evidence without moving money; set reconcile:false for a plain read.

operation_id.description: Settlement operation id (UUID) from prepare_arc_transfer or the operation field of a submit_arc_transfer result.

reconcile.description: Run the reconcile step before reading. Defaults to true.

name: get_arc_transfer
